official_rules.version: 2026 revision; modeling handoff only, no competition submission claimed

objectives: Design Q2-Q4 cross-day causal stochastic MPC/SDDP migration and verify a finite-tree mechanism; annual empirical execution pending.
decision_variables: Original and currently effective remaining contracts
constraints: One final comparison inventory target, not a daily target
assumptions: Undiscounted objective and no cash-flow constraints for deferred delivery accounting
Synthetic example has deterministic prices and no intraday amendment

candidates.name: cross_day_common_path_mpc
assumptions: Causal observations and common physical accounting
data_requirements: as-of forecasts and joint multi-day innovations
candidates.failure_mode: Common future battery actions lose adaptation

candidates.name: causal_tree_mpc
candidates.target_output: Adaptive near-horizon tree with correct tail state
assumptions: Causal observations and common physical accounting
data_requirements: as-of forecasts and joint multi-day innovations

candidates.name: markov_sddp_tail_mpc
candidates.target_output: Convex continuation-cost cuts plus near-horizon tree
assumptions: Causal observations and common physical accounting
data_requirements: as-of forecasts and joint multi-day innovations
candidates.failure_mode: Misspecified Markov information state or invalid stale cuts

selection_rationale.objective_fit: Continuous SOC and future energy opportunity cost without daily closure.
selection_rationale.constraint_fit: Causal contract and real-time action nodes; convex delivery accounting.
selection_rationale.data_fit: Requires as-of forecasts and multi-day innovations; original-data implementation pending.
selection_rationale.baseline: Keep the accepted daily-closure project frozen; use the independently verified synthetic full-tree LP for current mechanism validation.
risks: Invalid continuation cuts after random-model refitting
selection_rationale.fallback_trigger: First validate finite-tree MPC and a documented terminal-value baseline before deploying general SDDP.

execution.scope: Annual contest-data execution is not performed; separately recorded synthetic prototype completed.
